title: Linear Arrangement
tagline: Year 2 — Seating in one or two rows, left and right, position counts

introduction.overview: In a linear arrangement people sit or stand in one row (all facing the same way) or in two rows facing each other. You are given clues such as "A sits third to the right of B" or "C faces D" and must work out the order. The key skills are knowing left and right for people facing north or south, counting positions from either end, and placing definite clues before indefinite ones.
introduction.placementRelevance: Linear arrangement questions are commonly asked in company reasoning rounds, usually as a puzzle with a set of questions.
introduction.realWorldContext: Queues, classroom benches, stage photographs and parking rows are linear arrangements.

learningObjectives: Decide left and right for persons facing north or south
Place persons using definite and relative clues
Count positions from either end and between persons
Handle two rows facing each other

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: For people facing north, left is west and right is east. For people facing south, left is east and right is west. Position from left + position from right = total + 1.

coreDefinitions: Row: a straight line of people; the ends are the extreme left and extreme right.
Facing north/south: the direction people look; this decides what "left" and "right" mean.
Two-row arrangement: two parallel rows facing each other; each person faces exactly one person of the other row.
Immediate right/left: the adjacent person on that side.
Interchange: two persons swap their seats.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: The row is a numbered line of seats. "Third to the right of Q" means three seats in the right direction from Q. With a number line, every clue becomes arithmetic on seat numbers, and the left/right orientation is the only place where mistakes happen.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Draw n boxes in a row, mark "L → R" for the viewpoint of the sitters, and write each person into a box as soon as the clue fixes them.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Positions from the two ends
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Position from right = Total − position from left + 1
importantRulesAndFormulas.simpleExample: 8 persons: 4th from the left = 5th from the right

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Third to the right of X
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: Seat of X + 3 (for people facing north, in the left-to-right order)
importantRulesAndFormulas.description: Add for right, subtract for left.

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Two rows facing
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: The person at seat i from the left of row 1 faces the person at seat i from the right of row 2

importantRulesAndFormulas.title: Interchange
importantRulesAndFormulas.formula: After swapping, each takes the other's old seat

mainNarrative: Number the seats 1 to n from the left. For people facing north, "to the right of" means a higher seat number. In the row P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, the third to the right of Q is T, the middle person is S, and three persons (Q, R and S) sit between P and T.

Position from the other end: in a row of 8, the person fourth from the left is fifth from the right (8 − 4 + 1). The persons third from the left and second from the right (seats 3 and 7) have three persons between them (seats 4, 5, 6).

To solve a puzzle, place definite clues first. "A sits in the middle" fixes seat 3 of 5. "D sits at the immediate right of A" fixes seat 4. "B sits at the extreme right" fixes seat 5. The clue "E sits at the immediate right of C" must then put C in seat 1 and E in seat 2, giving C, E, A, D, B.

For two rows facing each other, the persons at opposite ends face each other when each row is listed from its own left to right: A faces F, B faces E and C faces D. To find the person to the immediate right of the one who faces B, locate E and move one seat right in row 2: F.
For an interchange, compute the new seat of each person, then answer the question. If B (seat 2) and G (seat 7) swap, B is in seat 7 and the immediate right of that seat is H.

deepDiveAspects.title: Facing south
deepDiveAspects.content: If people in a row face south, their left is east. Redraw the row from their viewpoint or flip left and right.

deepDiveAspects.title: Direct clues first
deepDiveAspects.content: Extreme positions, "middle" and "opposite" clues fix a seat immediately. Use "not adjacent" clues last.

problemVariations.exampleSnippet: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V

solvedExamples.title: Relative position
solvedExamples.question: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V sit in a row facing north in that order from left to right. Who sits third to the right of Q?
givenInfo: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V

solvedExamples.title: Puzzle
solvedExamples.question: Five persons A–E sit in a row facing north. A sits in the middle. D sits at the immediate right of A. B sits at the extreme right. E sits at the immediate right of C. Find the order from left to right.

steps.title: Definite clues
steps.explanation: A in seat 3; D in seat 4; B in seat 5.

steps.title: Remaining
steps.explanation: C and E for seats 1 and 2.

solvedExamples.title: Two rows
solvedExamples.question: Row 1 (facing south) from its own left to right: A, B, C. Row 2 (facing north) from its own left to right: D, E, F. A faces F, B faces E, C faces D. Who sits at the immediate right of the person who faces B?
givenInfo: A faces F, B faces E, C faces D
solvedExamples.conceptOrFormula: Find the facing partner, then move right.
solvedExamples.whyItWorks: Row 2 is read from its own left to right.

shortcutMethods.title: Number the seats

traditionalVsShortcut.shortcutMethod: Number seats 1 to n, place definite clues, convert relative clues to arithmetic, and check every clue at the end.

rulesForApplication: Position from right = total − position from left + 1.
For two rows, use own left to right.

placementTips.eliminationTechnique: Use the first definite clues to eliminate options.
placementTips.recruiterInsight: A clean diagram answers all questions.

easy.question:
Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is P, Q, R, S, T, U, V.

Who sits at the extreme right?
easy.explanation: The last person from the left is V.

easy.question:
Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is P, Q, R, S, T, U, V.

Who is third from the left?
easy.explanation: The 3rd from the left is R.

easy.question:
Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is P, Q, R, S, T, U, V.

Who sits third to the right of Q?
easy.explanation: Q is in seat 2. Three seats to the right is seat 5: T.

intermediate.question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.

Who sits fourth to the left of H?
intermediate.explanation: H is in seat 8. Four seats to the left is seat 4: D.

intermediate.question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.

Who sits exactly in the middle of C and G?
intermediate.explanation: C is seat 3 and G is seat 7. The middle is seat 5: E.

intermediate.question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. From left to right the order is A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H.

If B and G interchange their positions, who sits at the immediate right of B (in its new position)?
intermediate.explanation: After the swap B is in seat 7. The immediate right (seat 8) is H.

advanced.question:
Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits in the middle. D sits at the immediate right of A. B sits at the extreme right. E sits at the immediate right of C.

Who sits at the extreme left?
advanced.explanation: The order is C, E, A, D, B. The extreme left is C.

advanced.question:
Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits in the middle. D sits at the immediate right of A. B sits at the extreme right. E sits at the immediate right of C.

Who sits between E and D?
advanced.explanation: In the order C, E, A, D, B, A sits between E and D.

placementStyle.question:
Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits in the middle. D sits at the immediate right of A. B sits at the extreme right. E sits at the immediate right of C.

How many persons sit to the left of D?
placementStyle.explanation: C, E and A sit to the left of D: 3 persons.

placementStyle.question: Forty students stand in a row facing north. Rahul is 12th from the left and Suresh is 15th from the right. The number of students between them is
placementStyle.explanation: Suresh is 40 − 15 + 1 = 26th from the left. Between them: 26 − 12 − 1 = 13.

placementStyle.question: In a row of 25 persons, A is 7th from the left and B is 9th from the right. If they interchange, A becomes 17th from the left. A's new position from the right end is
placementStyle.explanation: B was 25 − 9 + 1 = 17th from the left. After the swap A takes that seat: 25 − 17 + 1 = 9th from the right.

selfCheckQuestions: Can I find the 3rd to the right?
Can I solve a five-person puzzle?
